summary.text: Deandre Barnes is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan State Senate, District 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a middle school teacher and Newport resident.

paragraphs.text: Barnes earned a high school diploma from Theodore Roosevelt High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Toledo in 2004 and a graduate degree from Purdue Global University in 2010.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as an educator.
Barnes advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he called his campaign "Focus On The Future" and said his priorities include modernizing the education system, expanding access to affordable healthcare and protecting natural resources.
He also said he supports public school funding without diverting taxpayer dollars to private voucher systems.
